scripts.install:all: pnpm --prefix server install && pnpm --prefix worker install
scripts.start: docker compose up -d && pnpm install:all && wait-on -t 30000 tcp:localhost:5435 && sleep 8 && pnpm --prefix server run db:generate && pnpm --prefix server run db:migrate && concurrently -n "server,worker" -c "cyan,yellow" "pnpm --prefix server dev" "pnpm --prefix worker dev"
